page.layout: One printed page. Centred title block at the top, then section I (a verse stanza with a decorative initial V), an attribution, section II (verse), and the catchword at the lower right. No marginal notes. The fragments at the right edge belong to the neighbouring page and are left out.

main_text.l: CL.V. D. JOHANNE STEKIO, IC. EDITI.

l.i: VERBA nihil scire est legum, si sensus
aberrat; Haec est Juridici regula prima chori.
Tu verba, & legum sensum bene perspicis; ergo
Juristas inter tu mihi primus eris.
Hinc, Ipse, fulmen horridum manu gerit;
Hinc, Mars coruscâ cassíde obnubit caput;
Hinc, quisq; signa fert sibi dati offici.

page.notes: The large initial V is a woodcut ornament joined to the first word. Ornamental rules above and below the section headings are not text. The small-capital words are rendered in capitals. Some letters in the verse are faint but read with reasonable certainty.
